# secopsctl info

Show the resolved instance configuration (no API call)

## info

Show the resolved instance configuration (no API call)

```text
secopsctl info
```

## info cron

Report local scheduler references to secopsctl automation (offline)

```text
secopsctl info cron [flags]
```

```text
Scan local scheduler-like files for secopsctl push/drift references.
Also scan pulled SOAR jobs/playbooks for cronSchedule values. With
--host, inspect the current user's crontab and user systemd files.
With --heartbeat-status, check explicit read-only heartbeat status
endpoints. Raw scheduler lines and heartbeat URLs are not echoed.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--heartbeat-status` | stringArray | - | check a read-only heartbeat status endpoint as <label>=<url> (repeatable; URL is not printed) |
| `--host` | bool | false | also inspect current user's crontab and user systemd unit files |
| `--root` | string | . | repository root to scan |

## info soar-integrations

Report SOAR integration runtime coverage (read-only)

```text
secopsctl info soar-integrations
```

```text
Report installed SOAR integration packs and whether they have configured
connector/job runtime bound to environments. Read-only: uses the SOAR
v1alpha integration catalog plus legacy connector/job runtime cards.
```

## info soar-system

SOAR platform version, license, and data retention

